name: Arrays & Hashing
description: Frequency maps, prefix sums and in-place array tricks.

name: Two Pointers
description: Walking two indices toward (or alongside) each other over sorted or symmetric data.

name: Sliding Window
description: Maintaining a moving range over an array or string in linear time.

name: Stack
description: LIFO processing, bracket matching and monotonic stacks.

name: Binary Search
description: Halving a sorted search space — on indices or on the answer itself.

name: Linked List
description: Pointer manipulation, fast/slow pointers and dummy nodes.

name: Trees
description: Binary tree and BST traversals, recursion and level-order BFS.

name: Heap / Priority Queue
description: Top-K, streaming medians and k-way merges with heaps.

name: Graphs
description: BFS, DFS, topological sort and union-find on grids and adjacency lists.

name: Backtracking
description: Exploring choices recursively and undoing them to enumerate solutions.

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Overlapping subproblems solved with memoization or bottom-up tables.

name: Greedy
description: Locally optimal choices that provably lead to a global optimum.

name: Intervals
description: Sorting, merging and sweeping over ranges.

name: Bit Manipulation
description: XOR tricks, bit counting and masks.

name: Tries
description: Prefix trees for fast word and prefix lookups.
